clue.text: Reviver, possibly, for father taking Swedish singer to capital

clue.text: Devoted admirer of one party? Dead right

clue.text: Specific treatment of the executive

clue.text: How a circular goes on and on!

parts.words: How a circular goes on and on!

clue.text: Uncommonly alert, not indulgent

clue.text: Range of colours permitted in an hors d'oeuvre
